P0652.title: Metabolomics-based search for lung cancer markers among patients with different smoking status

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文提供了关于环境暴露（烟草烟雾）如何干扰肿瘤生物标志物发现的实证证据。虽然其研究对象是肺癌而非肠道微生物群，但其方法论逻辑——即严格匹配关键环境变量以分离疾病特异性信号——对于理解免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效中的异质性具有参考价值。它展示了如何通过分层分析识别出受共同风险因素（吸烟 vs. ICI治疗副作用或生活方式）影响的代谢通路，可作为综述中讨论“混杂因素控制”或“宿主微环境影响”的类比案例或反面教材（即若忽略此类因素可能导致错误结论）。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 该研究关注的是诊断标志物的准确性，而非治疗响应机制；对象是肺癌/COPD，非ICI治疗下的实体瘤；不能直接外推至肠道菌群与ICI疗效的关系。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了在实体瘤中，强环境暴露（吸烟）如何掩盖或混淆疾病特异性生物标志物的具体实例。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 可用于论证在评估ICI疗效时，必须考虑患者的基线健康状况、合并症（如肺部基础病）或生活方式因素对免疫反应和代谢状态的潜在影响。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅描述了观察到的关联和作者提出的生物学解释（如氧化应激、TCA循环供能），未提供因果机制证据；不涉及肠道菌群产生的代谢物或其与免疫细胞的直接相互作用。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了特定代谢物（如谷氨酸、尿囊素）在癌症和炎症/氧化应激中的双重角色，表明代谢改变可能是多因素的。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 有助于解释为何某些代谢通路可能在多种干预背景下发生变化，提示在机制研究中需区分来源。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 作为讨论“宿主因素对肿瘤微环境和代谢影响”的背景材料。
broader_review_uses.material: 论文指出吸烟导致的代谢重塑（如抗氧化剂消耗、炎症介质增加）可能与肿瘤发生发展交织。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于支持综述中关于“除了肿瘤 intrinsic 特性外，宿主全身性状态（如慢性炎症、代谢紊乱）也是影响治疗结局的重要因素”的论点。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供生物标志物研究的方法论警示。
broader_review_uses.material: 论文强调未匹配吸烟史会导致假阳性，且药物（如茶碱）使用也会干扰代谢谱。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于提醒在综合ICI疗效相关研究时，需注意文献中是否控制了类似的混杂变量（如合并用药、基础疾病），以提高综述结论的可靠性。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究仅涉及吸烟者，不包含从不吸烟者，因此其发现的代谢特征可能不适用于非吸烟肺癌群体。
使用的COPD患者作为对照，虽然匹配了吸烟史，但COPD本身也是一种炎症性疾病，因此发现的差异是“肺癌 vs COPD+吸烟”，而非单纯的“肺癌 vs 健康”。
论文中的机制解释（如谷氨酸的作用）属于作者推测，并非本研究的实验验证结果。
topic_handles: 氧化应激标志物（尿囊素）

study_summary_A.approach: 研究设计采用多阶段工作流程：首先，利用液相色谱-高分辨四极杆飞行时间质谱（LC-HRMS）进行非靶向代谢组学筛查，比较LC与COPD全人群及按吸烟状态（当前/既往）分层的亚组；其次，根据统计结果筛选在各类比较中均显著且不受吸烟状态影响的候选代谢物；第三，开发并验证针对这些候选物的靶向三重四极杆质谱（LC-QTRAP-MS）方法以获取绝对浓度；最后，在独立的验证集中评估这些标志物的稳健性。统计分析包括PCA、火山图分析及t检验/Mann-Whitney U检验。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 证实了在肺癌代谢标志物研究中控制吸烟状态的重要性，提出了通过匹配吸烟背景的COPD对照来减少混杂偏见的策略。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 研究队列中缺乏“从不吸烟者”，限制了结果向非吸烟肺癌人群的推广；仅使用单一分析平台（LC-HRMS）进行非靶向筛查，可能遗漏部分代谢物类别；未对腺癌和鳞癌进行单独的统计分析。

key_findings.conditions: 在非靶向筛查中，当不区分吸烟状态时，发现9种HILIC模式和10种RP-LC模式的候选代谢物；但按吸烟状态分层后，各亚组间差异代谢物集合不同。
key_findings.finding: 苹果酸水平降低既见于LC也与吸烟相关，因此被排除作为LC特异性标志物；尿囊素、谷氨酸、琥珀酸和1-磷酸鞘氨醇在LC与COPD比较中表现出一致的显著差异。

key_findings.conditions: 在靶向验证阶段（发现集和验证集），比较LC与COPD患者。
key_findings.finding: 尿囊素、谷氨酸、琥珀酸和1-磷酸鞘氨醇在LC患者血清中显著降低，且在验证集中保持统计学显著性；肌苷和二油酰甘油虽在发现集中显著，但在验证集中未达显著水平。

key_findings.conditions: 按吸烟状态分层后的靶向验证。
key_findings.finding: 尿囊素、谷氨酸和琥珀酸在当前吸烟者和既往吸烟者亚组中均显示出显著的组间差异；1-磷酸鞘氨醇在亚组中趋势一致但未达统计学显著性（P接近0.05）。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 动机在于现有肺癌代谢组学研究常忽视烟草吸烟这一主要混杂因素，导致对照组（如健康人或COPD患者）与病例组的吸烟暴露不平衡，可能产生假阳性或混淆癌症特异性代谢改变与吸烟引起的代谢重塑。本研究试图解决如何从复杂的代谢背景中分离出真正由肺癌驱动而非仅由吸烟导致的生物标志物。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 研究对象为确诊的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者与慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者；情境为波兰某医疗中心，样本均为吸烟者（当前吸烟者或既往吸烟者），未包含从不吸烟者；范围聚焦于血清代谢组学特征及其与癌症状态和吸烟状态的关联。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究旨在探究在寻找肺癌生物标志物时，患者吸烟状态对代谢谱差异的影响。研究纳入了155名受试者（78名NSCLC患者和77名COPD患者），所有患者均有吸烟史。通过非靶向代谢组学筛选LC与COPD患者以及不同吸烟状态亚组间的代谢差异，随后采用靶向代谢组学对候选标志物进行绝对定量验证，并使用独立验证集进行外部验证。研究发现，基于吸烟状态分层显著影响了判别能力，最终确认尿囊素、谷氨酸、琥珀酸和1-磷酸鞘氨醇在区分LC与COPD患者中具有稳健的差异表达，而苹果酸等代谢物则同时受癌症和吸烟影响。

auxiliary_material.content: Method validation details: Calibration curves constructed using linear regression with surrogate matrix (2% bovine albumin in PBS), stability tests (autosampler, bench-top, freeze-thaw) indicating significant decrease (>15%) of inosine concentration after freeze-thaw or bench-top exposure.
auxiliary_material.relevance: Highlights critical pre-analytical conditions affecting inosine stability, useful for protocol optimization.

auxiliary_material.content: Confounding factor analysis: Study demonstrates that smoking status and medication (e.g., theophylline) significantly impact metabolite profiles, necessitating strict matching or stratification in biomarker studies.
auxiliary_material.relevance: Contextual warning for interpreting reference ranges; suggests that 'standard' ranges may vary by host factors like smoking.

auxiliary_material.content: Comparison of untargeted vs. targeted workflows: Untargeted LC-HRMS used for discovery, targeted triple-quadrupole MS used for absolute quantification, emphasizing the need for both steps in robust biomarker identification.
auxiliary_material.relevance: Methodological context for how quantification protocols are typically derived in this field.

chapter_tool_materials.question: 人体肿瘤微环境或血清中关键代谢物（如肌苷、短链脂肪酸）的具体生理浓度是多少，且是否与 ICI 响应直接相关？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: 现有文献尚未提供人体肿瘤微环境（TME）或配对血清中肌苷（Inosine）和短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）的具体生理浓度阈值及其与ICI响应的直接定量关联。关于肌苷，其促进ICI疗效的证据主要基于小鼠模型（如通过A2aR信号通路调节Th1分化），缺乏人类TME或血清中的实测浓度数据。对于SCFAs，临床证据多来源于粪便样本：在一项52例实体瘤患者接受抗PD-1治疗的研究中，较高的粪便乙酸、丙酸、丁酸和戊酸浓度与较长的无进展生存期（PFS）显著相关；在11例非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中，丙酸和丁酸也与长期有益效应相关。然而，这些研究未提供具体的绝对浓度值，且样本来源为肠道而非肿瘤微环境。此外，有证据显示高血清丁酸和丙酸浓度与抗CTLA-4治疗的疗效呈负相关，但同样缺乏具体的浓度阈值。唯一报道的具体定量代谢物指标是血清L-精氨酸，其浓度低于42 μM与不良预后相关，但这并非肌苷或SCFAs。因此，目前缺乏针对肌苷和SCFAs在人类TME或血清中与ICI响应直接相关的精确定量数据。
conditions: 多队列研究中的血清样本
limits: 需要寻找在人体肿瘤微环境（TME）或配对血清/血浆样本中，直接测量肌苷（Inosine）和短链脂肪酸（SCFAs，如乙酸、丙酸、丁酸、戊酸）绝对浓度（μM, ng/mL）的研究，并确认这些浓度值是否与ICI响应（如ORR, PFS）存在统计学关联。
chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: ['提供的文本未明确列出人类血清或肿瘤微环境中肌苷的绝对生理浓度数值（如μM 或 ng/mL），仅提供了基于中位数分层的高低组别比较数据。', '缺乏人类肿瘤组织微环境（TME）内肌苷浓度的直接定量数据，研究主要基于血浆样本，肿瘤内浓度是通过小鼠模型和 UBA6 表达间接推断的。', '在 22 人的独立验证队列中，由于样本缺失，未直接检测肌苷水平，而是使用 UBA6 蛋白表达作为替代标志物，因此缺乏该队列中代谢物与临床结局的直接统计关联。', '未提供短链脂肪酸（SCFA）在人类样本中与 ICI 响应的具体定量数据及统计关联，仅作为背景提及。']

chapter_tool_materials.question: 人体肿瘤微环境或配对血清中肌苷及短链脂肪酸的具体生理浓度是多少，且是否与 ICI 响应直接相关？

Although the objective response rate (26.7% vs 15.1%) did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.061), the data establish a clinical association between exogenous inosine exposure and improved ICI outcomes (PFS). Subgroup analyses indicated stronger PFS benefits in lung cancer patients (HR 0.45) and those with specific inflammatory markers (e.g., LDH≥216, NLR<4), suggesting patient stratification factors relevant to metabolite efficacy. This review identifies inosine and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) as key microbial metabolites influencing immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) efficacy. It reports that elevated fecal levels of acetate, propionate, butyrate, and valerate are associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS) and better treatment response in a prospective study of 52 solid tumor patients receiving anti-PD-1 therapy. It also cites evidence that high systemic butyrate and propionate levels correlate with CTLA-4 blockade resistance. Regarding inosine, the review describes a mechanism where B. pseudolongum-produced inosine translocates systemically to activate antitumor T cells and improve ICI efficacy. The text provides specific citation markers (e.g., [112], [156], [161]) pointing to primary studies that likely contain the raw concentration data and statistical associations required. This study investigated the role of Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) signaling via EP2 and EP4 receptors in regulating the tumor microenvironment (TME) and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response. The authors found that dual antagonism of EP2/EP4 (using DX-002) reversed PGE2-mediated immune suppression in NK cells and synergized with anti-PD1 therapy to increase CD8+ T cell infiltration and tumor regression in mouse models. The text notes that prior work has shown high levels of PGE2-EP2/EP4 associated inflammatory signatures correlate with poor prognosis and worse ICI response in multiple human cancer types, establishing a precedent for metabolite-mediated regulation of ICI efficacy. ['该研究在人类肾细胞癌（RCC）患者队列（CheckMate 025，n=394 nivolumab 治疗）中分析了血浆代谢谱，发现肌苷（inosine）水平与免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗后的总生存期（OS）显著相关（高肌苷组中位 OS 33 个月 vs 低肌苷组 22 个月，P < 0.01）。', '研究通过未靶向代谢组学确认了肌苷水平与 ICB 敏感性在 mouse 和 human 中均存在关联，且这种关联特异性存在于 ICB 治疗组（nivolumab），而不存在于 mTOR 抑制剂组（everolimus）。', '研究揭示了肌苷增强 ICB 疗效的分子机制：肌苷直接进入肿瘤细胞，抑制泛素激活酶 UBA6，从而上调 MHC-I 表达和炎症信号通路，增强肿瘤免疫原性。', '在包含 22 名实体瘤患者（食管、胃、肺、结肠癌等）的小型 basket trial 队列中，肿瘤组织 UBA6 蛋白表达水平（作为肌苷作用的下游指标）与抗 PD-1 治疗的客观缓解率（ORR）相关（低 UBA6 组 ORR 50% vs 高 UBA6 组 17%），且与 CD8+ T 细胞浸润负相关。'] This study prospectively analyzed 47 patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (R/R-DLBCL) receiving CD19 CAR T-cell therapy. It quantified serum inosine and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs: acetate, butyrate, isovalerate) using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. The authors reported that responders had significantly higher pretreatment serum inosine levels compared to non-responders (P = .042), and submedian serum inosine was an independent predictor of shorter progression-free survival (Multivariate HR 2.78, P = .024). For SCFAs, higher serum acetate and butyrate were associated with the absence of adverse events (CRS/ICANS), while elevated isovalerate was linked to the presence of adverse events. The study also identified an enrichment of inosine biosynthesis pathways in the gut microbiome of responders and demonstrated in vitro that inosine could enhance CAR T-cell cytotoxicity via the adenosine A2A receptor. limits: 需要寻找并提取具体的临床研究数据，这些数据必须包含：1. 在人类实体瘤患者的肿瘤组织（TME）或配对血清样本中测得的肌苷和/或短链脂肪酸的绝对浓度值（单位需明确为 μM 或 ng/mL）；2. 这些浓度值与 ICI 治疗结局（如客观缓解率 ORR、无进展生存期 PFS 等）之间的统计学关联分析。
chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: 提供的文本未报告人类血浆或肿瘤微环境中肌苷的绝对浓度数值（如 μM 或 ng/mL），仅使用了基于中位数的‘高/低’分组进行生存分析。成功标准要求的 ORR 或 PFS 与肌苷浓度的直接统计关联在文本中主要体现为 OS（总生存期），ORR/PFS 数据主要关联于 UBA6 表达而非肌苷浓度。此外，文本未提供短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）在人体内的具体浓度数据。人类肿瘤微环境（TME）中的肌苷浓度数据缺失，仅有血浆数据。

chapter_tool_materials.question: UBA6 蛋白在人体多种实体瘤中的表达谱及其与 ICI 疗效的大队列验证数据是否存在？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study provides extensive data on UBA6 expression profiles in human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) across multiple independent cohorts (e.g., E-MTAB-6134 n=288, TCGA n=129, and several GEO datasets), confirming significant upregulation at both transcript and protein levels compared to normal tissues. It establishes UBA6 as a robust prognostic biomarker associated with poorer overall survival in these general treatment cohorts. Additionally, it reports a consistent negative correlation between UBA6 expression and estimated CD8+ T cell infiltration across six cohorts, and includes pan-cancer expression analysis via GEPIA3 showing UBA6 overexpression in multiple tumor types. This study performed multiomics analyses using TCGA and CPTAC databases to profile UBA6 expression across tumor types. It reported that UBA6 mRNA levels were elevated in over 13 tumor types compared to normal tissues, and protein overexpression was observed in colon cancer and head and neck squamous cancer. Kaplan–Meier analysis indicated that high tumoral UBA6 levels were associated with worse overall survival in lung adenocarcinoma, kidney chromophobe, and clear cell renal cell carcinoma. The review also summarized that UBA6 knockdown suppressed growth in only 10.9% of analyzed cancer cell lines (n=582) in a CRISPR/Cas9 screening. This study conducted a real-world validation using a large propensity score–matched cohort (n=3,018 evaluable) to evaluate the association between mRNA COVID-19 vaccination around immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) initiation and outcomes in patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors (NSCLC, RCC, bladder cancer, melanoma). The authors found that vaccination within 100 days of ICI initiation was associated with significant improvements in real-world overall survival (rwOS) and progression-free survival (rwPFS), particularly in NSCLC, while melanoma showed no association with rwOS. This material provides a concrete example of large-scale human tumor cohort analysis regarding ICI efficacy modifiers, demonstrating the feasibility of stratifying outcomes by tumor type and external immune interventions. Although it does not measure UBA6, it establishes a benchmark for the scale and design (real-world evidence, propensity score matching) required to validate biomarker-ICI associations in the review limits: 需要寻找以下两类新材料：1. 系统性评估UBA6在多种实体瘤（至少3-5种不同组织类型）中蛋白或mRNA表达水平的研究，以明确其泛癌表达谱特征；2. 包含较大样本量（显著大于n=22）且接受过标准化ICI治疗的人类肿瘤队列研究，该研究需直接报告UBA6表达水平（或基因状态）与ICI治疗疗效指标（如客观缓解率ORR、无进展生存期PFS、总生存期OS）之间的统计学关联。
chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: The specific success criterion requiring large-scale human tumor cohort data linking UBA6 expression directly to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) clinical efficacy (e.g., response rate, PFS, or OS specifically in ICI-treated patients) remains unaddressed. The cohorts analyzed in this study reflect general PDAC prognosis (mostly surgery/adjuvant chemotherapy context) rather than ICI treatment outcomes. The human ICI validation data beyond the n=22 cohort mentioned in the gap context is not present in this material.

chapter_tool_materials.question: What standardized analytical protocols (LC-MS/MS or GC-MS parameters, sample processing standards) exist for quantifying absolute physiological concentrations of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human serum or tumor tissue, and are there cancer-specific reference ranges or consensus statements?
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study provides specific LC-MS/MS analytical parameters for quantifying adenosine and inosine in murine tumor tissues, including column type (ZORBAX RRHD Eclipse Plus C18), mobile phase gradients (water/acetonitrile with 0.1% FA), flow rate (300 µL min⁻¹), and MRM transitions (inosine 269.1/136.8, adenosine 268.1/135.9). It also describes a solid-phase microextraction (SPME) technique for measuring free metabolite concentrations in the tumor microenvironment using HLB-PAN fibers and kinetic calibration. A baseline adenosine concentration of 0.04 µM is reported for control mouse tumors. This study provides a detailed methodological framework for serum metabolite quantification using gas-chromatography/mass-spectrometry (GC/MS), which offers supporting technical parameters for the requested gap. The authors specify sample processing standards including serum separation (3,000 x g, 10 min, 4°C), storage conditions (−80°C), and extraction protocols (MeOH:H2O:CHCl3 = 2.5:1:1 with 2-isopropylmalic acid internal standard). The study outlines specific GC/MS instrument parameters such as column type (CP-SIL 8 CB), temperature programming (80°C to 330°C), and ion-source settings (200°C), along with quality control measures like calculating relative standard deviation (RSD%) and evaluating intra-day/inter-day variance. While the specific metabolites quantified (2-hydroxybutyrate, aspartic acid, kynurenine, cystamine) do not match the gap's target (inosine or short-chain fatty acids), the documented workflow serves as a reference template for establishing absolute physiological concentration protocols in human serum. The authors also demonstrate how to establish reference concentration ranges and cut-off values for cancer patients versus healthy controls using logistic regression and ROC analysis, providing a statistical model for defining cancer-specific reference ranges even though the specific analytes differ. The authors reported sample processing standards including tissue dissection, washing with precooled PBS, and storage at −80 °C prior to analysis. The results indicated a significant accumulation of acetic acid in tumor tissues compared to normal tissues, supporting the feasibility of SCFA quantification in tumor samples for cancer research.
